title: The Josephus Thesis Is Not the Piso Hypothesis EA-MPAI-JOSEPHUS-01 v1.1 — Disambiguation, Evidentiary Tiering, and Hostile Retrieval Correction
creator: Lee Sharks
description:
A thesis-level MPAI disambiguation packet by Lee Sharks separating the **Josephus Thesis** from the Piso Hypothesis and from broader Christ-myth theories.

The Josephus Thesis is presented as an available heteronymic reading of New Testament authorship: John, Paul, Peter, James, Luke, Mark, and Matthew may be read as differentiated author-functions within a Josephan literary system formed under Roman capture. The packet expressly denies deliberate conspiracy, Roman fabrication, hidden-code methodology, and exclusive historical certainty. It tiers historical-critical, papyrological, literary-structural, heteronymic, historiographic, and theological claims so that lower tiers can stand without acceptance of the more speculative ones.
